text: standard_normal_scales_data() returns standard scales data frame, start changing .
code: library(snp) standard_normal_scales()                                  # for figures about 7 inches wide standard_normal_scales(size = 5)                          # for figures about 12 inches wide standard_normal_scales(palette = "greens", mode = "dark")  # blues, reds, greens or diverging; light or dark ggsave("snp.png", standard_normal_scales(), width = 7, height = 3.2)  # your own scales: tick marks for a test score and bands for performance levels my_scales <- rbind(data.frame(scale = "SCORE", z = -3:3, z_end = NA, label = seq(20, 80, 10)),                    data.frame(scale = "LEVEL", z = c(-4, -1, 1), z_end = c(-1, 1, 4), label = c("Low", "Average", "High"))) standard_normal_custom(my_scales)

title: Plot the standard normal curve with your own score scales — standard_normal_custom
code: standard_normal_custom()  standard_normal_custom(palette="greens",mode="dark")  # your own scales: tick marks for a test score and bands for performance levels my_scales<-rbind(data.frame(scale="SCORE",z=-3:3,z_end=NA,label=seq(20,80,10)),                  data.frame(scale="LEVEL",z=c(-4,-1,1),z_end=c(-1,1,4),                             label=c("Low","Average","High"))) standard_normal_custom(my_scales,palette="diverging")  # start from the standard scales, drop the grades and add Wechsler scaled scores (mean 10, SD 3) scales<-standard_normal_scales_data() scales<-scales[scales$scale!="GRADE",] scales<-rbind(scales,data.frame(scale="SCALED",z=-3:3,z_end=NA,label=seq(1,19,3),colour=NA)) standard_normal_custom(scales)

text: scales placed z axis: z: standard score, mean 0 standard deviation 1. T: \(50 + 10z\). Percentile: z values 1st, 5th, 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th, 90th,     95th 99th percentiles. Sten: ten bands half standard deviation wide, sten 1 \(z = -2\)     sten 10 \(z = 2\) (mean 5.5, standard deviation 2). Stanine: nine bands half standard deviation wide, stanine 5     \(z = -0.25\) \(z = 0.25\) (mean 5, standard deviation 2). Grade: groups stanines, E (1-2), D (3), C (4-6), B (7) (8-9). IQ: \(100 + 15z\). coloured sten, stanine grade bands drawn thick lines, whose thickness follow size figure, figures ordinary size spill rows . standard_normal_scales draws chart fits figure size.
